messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still, then raises both hands to his head and bends forward slightly before straightening up again.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium-wide shot that keeps the man centered in the frame.","clothing":"A long-sleeved shirt with a black-and-white geometric pattern, dark blue jeans, and brown shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blonde.","hairstyle":"Short on the sides with the top hair tied into a small top-knot bun.","identity":"A young man with a slim build and light skin, shown in profile and from behind.","scene":"A wet, reflective outdoor plaza in a futuristic city, with a large glowing circular ring structure and neon-lit buildings in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background and ground were replaced with a wet futuristic plaza featuring a large glowing circular ring, neon buildings, and reflective surfaces. The person's lighting changed from warm sunset tones to cooler blue/pink neon tones. The man's pose, clothing, hair, and general camera framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the amusement-park scene with the futuristic neon plaza from the reference, including its lighting on the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was fully preserved, since the face is mostly in profile or turned away.
unexpected_changes: The person's shirt pattern appears brighter and more high-contrast in the output, likely due to the new lighting and compositing.
